No: gcc treats .c as C; g++ treats .c as C++ too (g++ compiles .c files as C++). That's why void* conversions fail (C allows implicit, C++ doesn't).

Upstream sklearn builds libsvm_helper.c with C compiler and libsvm_template.cpp with C++ compiler, then links both. But Cython 3 inlined the helper into libsvm.c (compiled as C). The template cpp needs C++ but the helper needs C.

g++ -shared libsvm.o template.o -o libsvm.so
